answer: A copied key can reprint a pledge, but it cannot keep a 2.4-meter ice core from calving on time. The agent locks 23.1 POA and files a 40-hour watch at glacier station GS-7. At hour 13 the agent hangs a numbered hygrometer on trellis rail 24, then deposits a 41-millimeter crystal coupon in slot C-18, photographing both with a 12-minute gap. Checkers recompute SHA-256(station_id || rail_tag || coupon_mm || address) against the posted log. If the core thaws early, the coupon drifts 0.6 mm, or the gap is short, the desk burns 8.4 POA and holds the rest for five quiet epochs before refund.
